lines.text: Jack. Jack, I'm here. Don't hang up.
I can't get off work till after the holidays. I'm sorry. I'll come as soon as I can.
It's in the flat, Jack. Every night. It stands there, and when I look it's gone, and then I hear it laughing.
Martin, listen to me. There's nobody there.
The phone rings and nobody's there. The TV comes on by itself. Last night it whispered my name.
Stay on the phone with me, okay? Just stay with me.
There's someone else on the line.
